scope: Proposition 8.3 (Full-stage path estimate) of the manuscript “Pure-Point Spectrum for the Two-Dimensional Anderson Model at Every Positive Disorder” (preprints/Pure-Point-Spectrum-for-the-Two-Dimensional-Anderson-Model-at-Every-Positive-Disorder-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 261 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 17487e3a2720b36f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 50. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is an absolute α > 0 such that, for the full stage-n good-core costs and all sufficiently large r up to a small fixed fraction of the torus side, P some nearest-neighbor crossing from Λr(x) to Λ2r(x)c has cost less than cnrα offset ! ≤ Cnr−50 . (8.10) Only costs of edges with both endpoints in the intervening band need be counted. The constants are uniform in the center and the allowed prescriptions.
